items.title: onboarding
items.name: Onboarding: from the first pixel to architectural judgment
items.prompt: Explain the two reading paths using web/app.js:18 and docs/README.md:1. Keep newcomer foundations separate from principal-level design tradeoffs.

children.title: principal-guide
children.name: Principal-level guide
children.prompt: Teach the baseline/candidate authority separation using web/app.js:712, server.mjs:1 and web/lib/review.js:1. Include a system diagram, domain ER model and clearly labelled Python pseudocode.

children.title: zero-to-hero
children.name: Zero-to-hero learning path
children.prompt: Explain pixels, cels, layers, frames and browser modules using web/app.js:18, web/app.js:453 and web/index.html:90. Build towards an editable animation and a safe proposal with worked exercises.

items.title: using-spritecanvas
items.name: Use the studio and collaborate safely
items.prompt: Document actual artist workflows from web/index.html:43 and web/app.js:379. Embed captioned screenshots from the isolated capture workflow in tests/docs/screenshots.spec.js:1.

children.title: studio
children.name: Tools, selections, layers, animation and exports
children.prompt: Explain active-cel boundaries, editing guards, copy/paste, timing and keyboard operations from web/app.js:40, web/app.js:379, web/app.js:453 and web/index.html:169.

children.title: collaboration
children.name: Handoff, comparison, feedback and genuine rebasing
children.prompt: Trace the human-facing review cycle using web/app.js:633, web/app.js:712, scripts/agent.mjs:1 and web/lib/review.js:1. Explicitly distinguish saved feedback from automatic agent notification.

children.title: branding
children.name: Scout anatomy and transparent editable branding
children.prompt: Document the separate editable icon, its current pose, equal-boot and eye invariants, local regeneration and subpath accessibility using web/assets/spritecanvas-logo.spritecanvas.json:1, scripts/brand.mjs:4 and tests/brand.test.mjs:1.

items.title: engine
items.name: Inside the pixel, rendering and review engine
items.prompt: Explain the actual shared data and algorithm layers from web/lib/model.js:1, web/lib/review.js:1, web/lib/storage.js:1 and web/lib/gif.js:1. Use worked examples and failure paths, not generic architecture claims.

children.title: project-model
children.name: Projects, validation, layers, frames and cels
children.prompt: Ground the exact schema, RGBA normalization, identity and editable-cell budgets in web/lib/model.js:1 and tests/model.test.mjs:1.

children.title: editing-algorithms
children.name: Discrete pixel editing algorithms
children.prompt: Trace line, shape, fill and transform logic using web/lib/model.js:1 and its UI callers in web/app.js:345. Include small-grid examples, clipping and selection/lock boundaries.

children.title: compositing
children.name: Rendering, alpha and presentation scale
children.prompt: Explain source-over compositing and export distinctions using web/lib/model.js:1, web/lib/export.js:31 and scripts/png.mjs:1. Distinguish native cells from enlarged display pixels.

children.title: review-protocol
children.name: The guarded proposal and feedback protocol
children.prompt: Document exact baseline checks, feedback status, replacement IDs and transitions from web/lib/review.js:1, server.mjs:1 and tests/review.test.mjs:1.

children.title: persistence
children.name: Autosave, atomic persistence and concurrency
children.prompt: Trace browser recovery, pending saves, revision conflicts and disk replacement from web/app.js:95, web/lib/storage.js:1 and server.mjs:1. State actual limits rather than assuming cross-process transactions.

children.title: bridge-cli
children.name: Loopback trust boundaries and agent CLI
children.prompt: Document endpoint contracts, headers, errors, navigation exception and safe CLI operations from server.mjs:1, scripts/agent.mjs:1 and tests/bridge.test.mjs:1.

children.title: gif
children.name: Adaptive animation-wide GIF quantization
children.prompt: Explain the actual histogram, adaptive palette, indexing, scaling, alpha and compression stages using web/lib/gif.js:1, web/lib/export.js:31 and tests/gif.test.mjs:1. Include the 26,624,000-pixel 16x example and its UI guard.

items.title: maintenance
items.name: Maintain, validate and publish
items.prompt: Explain contribution and publication boundaries using package.json:1, scripts/build.mjs:1, playwright.config.js:1 and scripts/check-docs.mjs:1. Build readiness is not a deployed-site claim.

children.title: tests-deployment
children.name: Tests, screenshots and static deployment
children.prompt: Document isolated tests and reproducible capture using playwright.config.js:1, playwright.docs.config.js:1, tests/docs/screenshots.spec.js:1 and scripts/build.mjs:1.

children.title: principles
children.name: Design principles with real tradeoffs
children.prompt: Explain static-first, review-first and editable-pixel principles using web/app.js:1095, web/app.js:712 and web/lib/model.js:1. Keep each principle focused and distinguish discussion from implementation.

children.title: static-first
children.name: A useful application without an API
children.prompt: Trace browser-only initialization and relative static assets using web/app.js:1095, web/lib/storage.js:1 and scripts/build.mjs:1.

children.title: review-first
children.name: A candidate is not authority to overwrite
children.prompt: Explain why acceptance is separate from proposal existence using web/app.js:712, web/lib/review.js:1 and server.mjs:1.

children.title: editable-pixels
children.name: The source is more than its rendered image
children.prompt: Explain layered source, derived exports, palette metadata and measurable anatomy checks using web/lib/export.js:31, web/app.js:666 and tests/brand.test.mjs:1.

children.title: reference
children.name: Glossary and source navigation
children.prompt: Maintain an accurate linked glossary and symbol/test map from web/lib/model.js:1, web/lib/review.js:1, server.mjs:1 and tests/model.test.mjs:1.

children.title: troubleshooting
children.name: Safe diagnosis and recovery
children.prompt: Explain failure diagnosis using web/app.js:31, web/app.js:95 and web/lib/export.js:31. Preserve unsynced artwork before resolving a conflict or testing a fix.
